kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اغلنثيت (form IIIq)
# اِغْلَنْثَيْتُ (iḡlanṯaytu) /iɣ.lan.θaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
# اِغْلَنْثَيْتَ (iḡlanṯayta) /iɣ.lan.θaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
# اِغْلَنْثَيْتِ (iḡlanṯayti) /iɣ.lan.θaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
